verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a rich CLI and API surface (channels, repos, workflows, agents) but every documented command operates on a single named item (e.g., 'buzz channels create --name', 'buzz repos protect set --id'); there is no documented batch/bulk mode, multi-item selector, or scripted bulk-operation feature across channels, repos, or agents. missing for 10: any documented bulk/batch command or API (e.g., bulk channel creation, bulk agent enrollment, bulk workflow triggering), evidence of looping/batch semantics in the CLI or API, independent confirmation of bulk usage.
